channel.title: Insider Media Ltd - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Insider Media Ltd (insidermedia.com)

item.title: Footasylum extends bank facility to £60m - will support store roll-out programme
item.description: Sportswear and streetwear retailer Footasylum is accelerating its UK expansion plans after extending its revolving credit facility with HSBC UK from £35m to £60m.

item.title: UK economy flatlines unexpectedly in January
item.description: The UK economy unexpectedly stalled in January following meagre growth at the end of last year, official figures have shown, amid fears Britain is heading for a hit from the Iran conflict as prices are sent soaring.

item.title: Lancashire skincare entrepreneur secures £50k investment offer on Dragons' Den in 'defining moment'
item.description: A Lancashire-based entrepreneur has secured a £50,000 investment offer from Touker Suleyman after pitching her specialist skincare brand on BBC's Dragons' Den.

item.title: M&S reopens Anlaby Hull food store - event attended by Hull FC players
item.description: M&S has reopened its Anlaby Hull food store following a six-week refurbishment.

item.title: Acquisition of grade II-listed Nottingham War Rooms completes - "exciting new chapter" for the former Cold War bunker
item.description: A building in Nottingham originally constructed during the Cold War as one of 17 Regional War Rooms across England and Scotland to withstand a nuclear strike has been acquired in a deal that will allow the site's regeneration to advance.

item.title: Takeover offer for glasses maker made by consortium fronted by serial investor declared unconditional - values eyewear group at £85.4m
item.description: A takeover offer for a South West-headquartered glasses maker by a consortium fronted by well-known entrepreneur and investor Luke Johnson has been declared unconditional.

item.title: Scotland to benefit from £50m Defence Growth Deal - "Scotland is not just part of the UK's defence story - it is vital to it"
item.description: A £50m Defence Growth Deal has been announced for Scotland including funding for new engineering and innovation facilities.

item.title: Shortlists unveiled for Insider’s North West Young Professionals Awards 2026
item.description: Insider can today reveal the shortlists for the North West Young Professionals Awards 2026, which celebrate rising talent aged 35 and under across the region.

item.title: Stelrad boosts free cash flow despite softer demand impacting revenue
item.description: Free cash flow more than doubled at radiator manufacturer Stelrad Group in its latest full financial year, although revenue was impacted by subdued demand in its core territories of UK and Ireland and Europe.

item.title: EG Group's Cumberland Farms acquires US convenience and fuel retailer
item.description: EG Group's Cumberland Farms has agreed to acquire Coen Markets, a long-established convenience and fuel retailer with deep roots in the Pittsburgh area with operations spanning Western Pennsylvania, Eastern Ohio, and Northern West Virginia.
